persons.name: Vidyānanda
persons.evidence: vacājya vidyānadana thavata dayakā juro ... thva saphuri coyāo dayakaṃ tayā juloḥ

place.as_written: yaṃ kāṣṭhamaṇḍapamahānagale sa yeva torake, sikomuguri talamulamahāvihāre, jhorache

purpose: for reciting the story annually to patrons (vaṣapatiṃ bākhana kana oneyā nimittana)
